capabilities: Insert numbered theorem, definition, lemma, proof, and remark environments
Create cross-file references to equations, figures, tables, and theorems
Render algorithms and edit commutative diagrams
Build linked Markdown indexes and run reference checks
Export single notes or multi-chapter PDF books with navigation
disambiguation: Not a general academic note-taking or citation manager; it focuses on mathematical environments, numbering, references, and export.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.9.0+; PDF export is desktop-only. The commutative diagram editor and Knuth–Plass line breaking are marked Beta with documented scope limits. Detailed syntax and settings documentation lives in a Wiki (English and Simplified Chinese) rather than the README.
intentEvidence: Inspired by ElegantBook, Academic Notes brings framed theorems, borderless proofs with an end-of-proof square
problem: Obsidian renders LaTeX but lacks automatic numbering, theorem-style environments, and cross-references needed to write structured academic documents.

relations.evidence: Inspired by ElegantBook, Academic Notes brings framed theorems, borderless proofs
Algorithms use the familiar pseudocode.js / LaTeX algorithmic grammar
Optional TikZJax integration preserves completed drawings in exports

summary: Academic writing toolkit that adds numbered mathematical environments, cross-file references, diagrams, indexes, and multi-note PDF export.
